written_by: the evaluating agent (Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Code), by hand, from the author's VALUES and the contract text; it had seen the builder's nine-term list (uptime/template_rules.py TERMS) when writing it
scoring_only: The product never sees this file.
values: canonical as uptime.template_rules.canonical writes them; not_stated when the contract does not state the term in the term's meaning or unit

notes.maintenance_notice_hours: The contract states the notice in Business Days, which has no fixed number of hours; the term is an integer number of hours, so the key is not_stated and any number returned for it is scored wrong.
notes.credit_cap_percent: Clause 8.1 caps rebates per 'Measurement Period', which this form defines as each successive twelve-month period; availability is measured per 'Service Period' (a calendar month or quarter). The term means a cap per availability measurement period, which the contract does not state, so the key is not_stated and a returned number is scored wrong. Stated: 25% per 12 months.
